v3.lede: One shop, at 1633 Boulder City Pkwy. Vehicles come here for tint and chip repair. For homes and offices we come to you.
story: BC Glass & Tint is a family-owned and operated shop, tinting windows in Boulder City and across Southern Nevada since 1994.

Satisfaction guaranteed is written across our logo. The window film we install carries a lifetime manufacturer warranty on the film. If something about your install is not right, call or stop by the shop, Tuesday to Saturday, 9 to 5.
v3.bay_text: Chip repair and car tint are done here, in our own bay. Most vehicles are tinted the same day, and most chips are fixed the same day. Ask to hold the film against your glass before we start.
